title: Decision No. 27 of 2020 Concerning the Extension of the Mandate of the Transitional High Judicial Council
text:
Decision No. 27 of 2020

 Concerning the Extension of the Mandate of the Transitional High Judicial Council

 The President of the State of Palestine
 

 The Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organisation
 

In reference of the Bylaw of the Palestine Liberation Organisation,

The Amended Basic Law of 2003, as amended,

Having reviewed the Law on the Judicial Authority No. 1 of 2002,

The Law by Decree No. 17 of 2019 on the Establishment of a Transitional High Judicial Council, particularly Article 4 thereunder,

Based upon the recommendation of the Transitional High Judicial Council, in its Session No. 10/2020, convening on June 17th, 2020,

Based upon the powers vested in me, and

In pursuance of the public interest,

 I hereby promulgate the following Decision:
 

 Article 1

The mandate of the Transitional High Judicial Council, which has been established in accordance with Article 3 of the Law by Decree No. 17 of 2019 on the Establishment of a Transitional High Judicial Council, shall be extended for a period of six months, starting from July 16th, 2020.

 Article 2

All provisions that contradict the provisions of this Decision shall be repealed.

 Article 3

All the competent authorities, each one within its sphere of jurisdiction, shall implement the provisions of this Decision and shall enter into force as of the date of its promulgation and shall be published in the Official Gazette.

 Promulgated in the city of Ramallah on June 18th, 2020 Anno Domini,
 

 Corresponding to Shawwal 26th, 1441 Anno Hegira.
 

 Mahmoud Abbas
 

 President of the State of Palestine
 

 Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organisation
